steps.note: Open an existing event with bids as the closest available starting point for the vendor quote.
Move to the supplier portal so the vendor's quote can be inspected.
Open the event's pricing quote in the vendor portal.
Switch to the third quote tab; the tab label is not otherwise defined in the catalog.
Scroll the quote so its paged rows are rendered.
Assert that loading tab 3 issued the quote-details request with the selected tab and a page parameter.
Assert that quote rows are rendered after switching tabs, without claiming their specific line-number ownership.
